tldr: North Node in House 6: growth through daily rhythms, health maintenance, work habits, service, and practical repair.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop daily rhythms, health maintenance, work habits, service, and practical repair. The South Node in House 12 shows the familiar life field: avoidance, isolation, hidden burdens, spiritual bypassing, or drifting. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to make healing repeatable in ordinary life.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses daily rhythms, health maintenance, work habits, service, and practical repair in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 12 can pull the person back toward avoidance, isolation, hidden burdens, spiritual bypassing, or drifting.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
